component.name: Ycode
component.summary: An independent IDE for Swift and Apple-platform project formats

description.p: Ycode is an independent, open-source IDE. It opens, edits and builds Swift packages and projects in the Xcode project format. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

This Flatpak uses the Swift toolchain installed on your computer: it reaches it through the Flatpak portal with flatpak-spawn --host, which also means the app is not really sandboxed. Without a toolchain on the host it tells you what to install. The simulator tools are experimental, and the simulator needs a runtime from your own copy of the platform tools.

Second beta: the Linux IDE gains debugging, source control, tests, language features, the structured editors, the rest of Settings and the coding assistant, and simulator runtimes can be fetched and set up from the IDE.
First public beta: the IDE, with the simulator tools marked experimental.
